watch.2: the cafe's corner lamp on a tide night (3 nights in 7), and whether the Jinrui lobby ever dims

lines: Filed: your walk to the waterline on {date}. The next page of the file opens on its own date. I am not stalling. Mostly.
The front desk still has your visit from {date} on the screen. Somebody wrote "the one who walks" next to it. I did not correct it.

spot.line: A sticky note on the slab now, in Lacia's neat hand: "Visitor: the one who walks. Do not correct."

lines: You saw a wave dim {place} on {date}. If you remember which light went first, tell me. I will put it next to the cafe's list.
